summary: Liora and Nereth enter the ancient damping chamber and discover that its core hardware predates much of the network it is now expected to save.
panelPlan: Large establishing panel of dormant emitters, old structural ribs, and later-era cabling grafted onto much older machinery.
Liora compares component dates against the modern network expansion record.
Nereth follows a control line into a twisted lattice of retrofits.
End on the realization that the emergency system was never rebuilt for the load now resting on it.
directionInline: The chamber should feel maintained enough to exist but historically layered and under-modernized.

summary: Nereth warns that a misaligned damping cycle would shear the network rather than relieve it.
panelPlan: Nereth maps the damping geometry against the expanded corridor lattice.
A simulated pulse crosses the old design cleanly, then distorts when modern branches are added.
The projected field splits under a small alignment error.
End on Nereth naming the consequence of firing crooked.
directionInline: Make the failure mode visually legible before the real attempt begins.

summary: Liora commits to aligning the system themselves and explicitly rejects outside interference in the calibration.
panelPlan: Liora shuts off nonessential remote-control channels and isolates the engineering console.
Nereth verifies the local calibration path.
Dormant emitters sputter awake one by one through floating dust.
End on Liora insisting that no one alter the configuration once the cycle begins.
directionInline: This creates the causal condition that the later override will violate.

summary: Behind closed doors, Lochran decides the damping attempt must also produce visible stability metrics that can preserve public confidence.
panelPlan: Open on Lochran closing the Nexus door against the noise of worsening incident traffic.
He brings up the damping operation beside public confidence dashboards and communications planning.
A control option labeled as stability coefficients is introduced into the discussion.
Damiar sees that Lochran is extending political requirements into an engineering intervention.
directionInline: Treat the override as an institutional attempt to shape measurable output, not a cartoon sabotage command.

summary: Damiar accepts the override plan and prepares language to dismiss any engineering objection as calibration variance.
panelPlan: Damiar studies the coefficient package and hesitates over the engineering warnings attached to it.
Lochran remains fixed on the need for a stable public readout.
Damiar writes the contingency phrase that will minimize objections if engineers protest.
End on the override package leaving the closed room for deployment.
directionInline: Play Damiar as knowingly complicit in the override decision rather than as someone who misunderstands it.

summary: In the Outer Band, Ruvian watches a critical node vibrate out of pattern while the damping attempt is being prepared elsewhere.
panelPlan: Wide outer-ring engineering space with warning stripes flickering and a deep structural shudder traveling through the floor.
Ruvian places a hand on a support and feels the vibration before the instruments catch it.
A beacon log shows the node slipping out of the expected harmonic rhythm.
End on a fastener or brace visibly working loose under the repeated pulse.
directionInline: Keep the physical danger immediate and tactile.

summary: The outer technician warns that if the damping chamber fails, neglected peripheral stations will absorb the first catastrophic consequences.
panelPlan: The technician marks the Outer Band’s position on a network load map.
Failure propagation reaches the outer stations before the protected central routes.
Ruvian compares the projection to the hardware already shaking around them.
End on the technician demanding that the Core understand who is carrying the first risk.
directionInline: Establish that peripheral stations carry the first and greatest exposure if the intervention fails.

summary: Liora begins the damping cycle and the ancient emitters answer unevenly before settling into a narrow alignment.
panelPlan: Power enters the chamber in staged increments; old emitters flare at slightly different moments.
Liora and Nereth correct phase differences locally.
The floor shivers hard enough to force them to brace.
End on the pulse pattern finally beginning to line up.
directionInline: Build tension through imperfect startup rather than immediate success.

summary: For the first time in cycles, the harmonic field visibly stabilizes and corridor stress starts to ease.
panelPlan: The chamber pulse becomes regular and the fractured glow around the emitters smooths into one rhythm.
Liora watches the stress curve bend downward.
A remote corridor trace that had been oscillating settles into a clean line.
End on Liora calling the field alignment holding, barely.
directionInline: Allow a real moment of earned hope.

summary: Nereth confirms two-percent drift—the best reading they have seen in cycles—while both know the margin remains dangerously small.
panelPlan: Nereth checks independent instruments to confirm the improvement is real.
The two-percent figure holds across more than one sensor.
Liora keeps her hands on the controls instead of celebrating.
End on the stabilized field surrounded by amber warning limits.
directionInline: Keep the improvement visibly real but fragile, surrounded by narrow safety margins and warning limits.

summary: A Coalition technician receives the remote override while the chamber is already running and sees that its parameters contradict the active calibration.
panelPlan: Open on the technician’s console as the live engineering matrix and incoming override appear side by side.
Several values fail validation or sit outside the active matrix assumptions.
The technician checks the authorization signature rather than immediately deploying.
End on the Council order remaining active despite the mismatch.
directionInline: The technician should clearly understand there is risk.

summary: Lochran orders the override executed anyway because the operation must produce reassuring metrics, and the technician obeys.
panelPlan: Lochran appears over the command channel demanding execution.
The technician looks from the authorization to the contradictory values.
A final warning prompt is acknowledged.
End on the override routing into the live damping cycle as console lights turn amber.
directionInline: The final panel must make the causal intrusion unmistakable.

summary: Inside the chamber, a new surge enters a configuration Liora and Nereth did not authorize.
panelPlan: The previously regular pulse develops a second rhythm underneath it.
Liora sees control values change without her input.
One emitter fires early and another compensates too late.
End on Liora recognizing that the live configuration is no longer theirs.
directionInline: Show the exact moment external control breaks the local calibration.

summary: Nereth traces the surge to newly pushed coefficients that do not match the damping matrix.
panelPlan: Nereth pulls the remote-change history while the chamber begins to shake.
The new coefficient set is highlighted against the calibrated matrix.
He identifies the mismatch as the source of the divergence.
A stronger pulse hits before they can roll it back.
directionInline: Keep the causal chain clear: override, mismatch, instability.

summary: The corrupted cycle turns violent, throwing Nereth into a railing as emitters fall out of sequence.
panelPlan: A violent harmonic surge crosses the chamber and throws Nereth sideways.
Liora grabs the console while fractured pulses jump across multiple emitters.
Nereth struggles back toward the controls as alarms cascade.
End on the field feeding energy back into itself instead of damping.
directionInline: This is the physical point of no return for the experiment.

summary: Liora chooses shutdown over salvage and slams the manual abort before the feedback can grow further.
panelPlan: Liora abandons attempts to recover alignment and reaches for the manual shutdown plate.
Nereth warns through the alarms while another surge builds.
Liora orders shutdown and strikes the abort.
Final panel: emitters die unevenly, leaving residual distortion in the chamber instead of returning to clean darkness.
directionInline: The shutdown stops the machine but does not undo what the corrupted pulse already released into the network.

summary: A ship in transit reports its own silhouette trailing behind it in open space after the failed damping cycle.
panelPlan: Open outside the ship with warped starlight and a delayed duplicate outline following the hull.
Inside, the captain watches a second version of the ship appear on sensors where nothing should be.
Crew members compare viewport and instrument readings and see the same impossible effect.
End on the captain calling the anomaly in.
directionInline: Make the duplicate clearly temporal or harmonic, not a second physical ship.

summary: Liora receives the transmission and identifies the doubling as harmonic folding rather than an optical error or superstition.
panelPlan: Liora listens from a damaged chamber console while the captain’s distorted feed plays beside network data.
She matches the delayed silhouette to the post-shutdown harmonic residue.
The duplicate ship image flickers closer to the real hull on the feed.
End on Liora naming the effect and understanding its scale.
directionInline: Her explanation should reduce mystery while increasing danger.

summary: More corridor traces begin slipping their anchors, proving the failed intervention has propagated beyond the damping chamber.
panelPlan: Several route feeds populate beside the captain’s report with similar phase offsets.
A stable anchor marker drifts relative to its corridor path.
Liora watches the anomaly spread across more than one arc.
End on the network map showing the first visible tearing pattern.
directionInline: No new dialogue; let propagation carry the beat.

summary: Lochran tries to hold to containment as alarms begin sounding across multiple worlds and Council aides abandon normal procedure.
panelPlan: Establish Cooperative corridors in disorder: aides running, alarms crossing over public announcements.
Lochran insists that the event can still be contained while trying to maintain command posture.
Incident displays behind him add world after world.
End on his repeated claim visibly contradicted by the environment.
directionInline: This is the collapse of Lochran’s old operating assumption, not yet of the network itself.

summary: Damiar breaks with the reassurance strategy and says the public deserves the truth.
panelPlan: Damiar looks from the emergency boards to the prepared reassurance language still open on a nearby display.
He closes or discards the old messaging draft.
Facing Lochran directly, he says the alarms now outrun their narrative.
End on Lochran realizing he has lost Damiar’s support for containment messaging.
directionInline: Mark Damiar’s turn through action as well as dialogue.

summary: Iskari declares prevention over and orders preparation for coordinated failure, ending the issue on the shift from control to triage.
panelPlan: Iskari arrives through the running aides and does not stop to debate the old plan.
She brings up a triage map organized around likely failures rather than continued normal service.
Liora’s warnings, outer-node risk, and current alarms converge on the same map.
Final wide panel: the three leaders face a network already entering failure as Iskari names the new reality.
directionInline: End on a strategic phase change: the story is no longer about preventing crisis, but surviving it.
